phases.name: Stabilization Baseline
phases.objective: Lock baseline and enforce orchestrator guardrails.

phases.name: Workflow Hardening
phases.objective: Contract + validation reliability for all workflows.

phases.name: Bridge and Sidecar Reliability
phases.objective: Schema parity and failure-safe bridge behavior.

phases.name: Performance and Observability
phases.objective: Latency and throughput tuning with deep visibility.

phases.name: Release Readiness and Scale
phases.objective: Controlled rollout with automation and runbooks.

tasks.title: Freeze production baseline matrix
tasks.deliverable: Versioned baseline matrix for engines, workflows, and env parity.
tasks.acceptance: All 16 engines and 6 workflows are listed with deployed version and runtime parity.

tasks.title: Enforce orchestrator-only API routing
tasks.deliverable: Assertions and tests preventing direct handler-to-engine execution.
tasks.acceptance: All engine/workflow API tests fail if call path bypasses orchestrator.

tasks.title: Unify EngineError HTTP translation
tasks.deliverable: Single EngineError-to-HTTP mapping table and tests.
tasks.acceptance: Error status/body outputs are deterministic for every EngineError variant.

tasks.title: Tighten orchestrator input validation
tasks.deliverable: Validation rules and pre-fanout guard tests.
tasks.acceptance: Invalid inputs are rejected before engine execution with explicit validation messages.

tasks.title: Workflow registry parity check
tasks.deliverable: Startup and CI check for six workflow IDs.
tasks.acceptance: CI fails when any workflow route is missing or mismatched.

tasks.title: Normalize cache key builder
tasks.deliverable: Canonical cache key generator shared by engines and workflows.
tasks.acceptance: Equivalent requests produce identical keys in tests and replayed traffic.

tasks.title: Verify Redis degradation fallback
tasks.deliverable: L1-only fallback test path and alert policy notes.
tasks.acceptance: Service remains functional with bounded latency increase when Redis is unavailable.

tasks.title: Contract tests: birth-blueprint + daily-practice
tasks.deliverable: Integration contract tests for two workflows.
tasks.acceptance: Required schema fields are stable and deterministic across fixture runs.

tasks.title: Contract tests: decision-support + self-inquiry
tasks.deliverable: Integration contract tests for two workflows.
tasks.acceptance: Witness synthesis envelope and metadata fields are validated in CI.

tasks.title: Contract tests: creative-expression + full-spectrum
tasks.deliverable: Integration contract tests for two workflows.
tasks.acceptance: Golden fixtures detect schema drift and fail CI on mismatch.

tasks.title: Unify bridge timeout and retry policy
tasks.deliverable: Shared timeout/retry config for all bridge calls.
tasks.acceptance: Bridge telemetry shows consistent timeout and retry behavior across TS engines.

tasks.title: Harden TS sidecar health probes
tasks.deliverable: Readiness/liveness probe endpoints with dependency checks.
tasks.acceptance: Sidecar fails readiness on downstream faults and recovers correctly.

tasks.title: Bridge schema parity across 5 TS engines
tasks.deliverable: Shared envelope adapters and parity fixtures.
tasks.acceptance: All TS engine responses conform to orchestrator-consumable schema.

tasks.title: Add sidecar circuit-breaker protection
tasks.deliverable: Circuit-breaker for bridge failures with recovery states.
tasks.acceptance: Open/half-open/closed transitions are exercised and request storms are prevented.

tasks.title: Publish per-engine latency histograms
tasks.deliverable: Prometheus metrics and alert rules for engine/workflow latency.
tasks.acceptance: Dashboards show p50/p95/p99 with actionable alert thresholds.

tasks.title: Trace correlation API to sidecar
tasks.deliverable: Cross-service trace propagation and span conventions.
tasks.acceptance: One request trace links API, orchestrator fan-out, bridge, and sidecar spans.

tasks.title: Refresh benchmark suite for 11 Rust engines
tasks.deliverable: Updated benches and baseline benchmark report.
tasks.acceptance: All core Rust engines are benchmarked with repeatable output.

tasks.title: Tune orchestrator fan-out concurrency
tasks.deliverable: Concurrency configuration and safeguards under load.
tasks.acceptance: Mixed workflow throughput improves without error-rate regression.

tasks.title: Run mixed workflow load profile
tasks.deliverable: Load scripts and result report for representative traffic.
tasks.acceptance: Target RPS is sustained within defined p95 latency budget.

tasks.title: Auth soak test and key rotation drill
tasks.deliverable: Supabase auth soak logs and key rotation runbook.
tasks.acceptance: Rotation executes without downtime and token validation remains stable.

tasks.title: Add idempotency keys for workflow submissions
tasks.deliverable: Idempotency handling for duplicate workflow requests.
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate requests return canonical result or explicit safe-conflict response.

tasks.title: Curate validation fixture packs
tasks.deliverable: Versioned fixtures for engines and workflows.
tasks.acceptance: Fixtures cover happy paths plus timezone and edge-date scenarios.

tasks.title: Align docs to orchestrator-first usage
tasks.deliverable: Updated API/docs language with orchestrator-first flow.
tasks.acceptance: No docs suggest direct engine invocation from API handler paths.

tasks.title: Automate Railway post-deploy smoke tests
tasks.deliverable: Smoke automation for health, engines list, and workflow execution.
tasks.acceptance: Deploy only marked healthy after smoke workflow success.

tasks.title: Define canary rollout policy
tasks.deliverable: Canary configuration and rollback triggers.
tasks.acceptance: Canary aborts automatically on threshold breaches and rollback path is proven.

tasks.title: Write orchestrator failure-mode runbook
tasks.deliverable: On-call runbook for top orchestrator/bridge incidents.
tasks.acceptance: On-call can triage and mitigate top five failures in under 15 minutes.

tasks.title: Backfill engine selection integration tests
tasks.deliverable: Selection matrix test suite for workflows and explicit engine routes.
tasks.acceptance: Correct engine set is selected for each workflow and route definition.

tasks.title: Add cache invalidation hooks for ephemeris updates
tasks.deliverable: Data-change invalidation triggers and tests.
tasks.acceptance: Updated source data invalidates stale cache entries without global flush.

tasks.title: Align TS error taxonomy to EngineError
tasks.deliverable: TS-to-EngineError mapping contract.
tasks.acceptance: Bridge consistently converts TS faults into stable EngineError categories.

tasks.title: Run release gate review and signoff
tasks.deliverable: Release candidate checklist with go/no-go decision.
tasks.acceptance: All blocking tasks are closed and 72h stability window passes.

risks: Bridge response schema drift across TypeScript engines
Observability blind spots under mixed workflow fan-out
